name: Wolf's Court
description: A magical site in the forest of the Majarida Mountains where the She-Wolf grants supplicants the power to take vengeance, often by becoming werewolves.

name: Fane of Vengeance
description: The remnants of a Roman shrine to vengeance at the Wolf's Court; they are not essential to the Court, and if destroyed the She-Wolf may move to another Magic aura.

name: She-Wolf
description: A magical Aspect of the Daimon of Revenge who presides over the Wolf's Court, grants powers of vengeance, and trains the Wolves of Virtue of the region.

name: Daimon of Revenge
description: The Daimon behind the She-Wolf and the Luperci cult; the She-Wolf is one of its Aspects, and it sends creatures of judgment to watch over new magistri.

name: Poine
description: The titan of vengeance and retribution and mother of the Erinyes; Tytalus's Prosopopoeia names the She-Wolf as her Aspect.

name: Erinyes
description: The children of Poine, titan of vengeance, according to Tytalus's writings.

name: Luperci
description: A secret Mystery Cult linked to the She-Wolf that punishes the guilty when ordinary justice fails, usually by having them killed by a wolf.

name: Fabiani
description: One of the two colleges of the Luperci, named after the ancient Roman Fabia family; it is led by its own magister luperci.

name: Quinctiliani
description: One of the two colleges of the Luperci, named after the ancient Roman Quinctilia family; it is led by its own magister luperci.

name: Fabia
description: An ancient Roman family (genus) that ran the Luperci and gave its name to the Fabiani college.

name: Quinctilia
description: An ancient Roman family (genus) that ran the Luperci and gave its name to the Quinctiliani college.

name: Lupellis
description: The most junior grade of the Luperci. It requires Organization Lore: Luperci 1, and Initiates gain the Skinchanger Virtue and the Dark Secret Flaw.

name: Lupercus
description: The second grade of the Luperci, Initiated just after a vengeance killing. It grants Scales of the Heart or Confession of the Penitent as a Lesser Power, together with the Judged Unfairly Flaw.

name: Magister Luperci
description: The third and highest grade of the Luperci. There are only two at any time, one per college, and each is the mystagogue for all Initiations within his college.

name: Lykaia
description: A rite performed at Lupercalia by a prospective magister luperci: he eats a meal tainted with human flesh and must remain in wolf form for at least nine seasons.

name: Lupercalia
description: A festival held from 13 to 15 February at which all luperci of a region may try to dispel curses laid on the community, drawing on the Daimon of Revenge.

name: Organization Lore: Luperci
description: An Ability that sets eligibility for each Luperci grade and replaces Magic Lore when the magister invokes the She-Wolf; it is also used to dispel curses at Lupercalia.

name: Organization Lore: Roman Empire
description: An Organization Lore Ability; Ovid's Fasti is a summa on it.

name: Magic Lore
description: An Ability normally used to invoke powers through Spiritual Pact. Tytalus's Prosopopoeia is a summa on it, and it can reveal that the She-Wolf is an Aspect.

name: Mystery Cult
description: A secret society with grades and Initiations; the Luperci are one, and a sidebar presents them as a possible Hermetic Mystery cult.

name: Initiation
description: The process of gaining a Mystery cult's Virtues through scripted rites with an Ease Factor; Gifted characters need not take an Ordeal at every Initiation.

name: Ordeal
description: A part of Initiation. Gifted individuals do not have to take an Ordeal at every Initiation and can benefit from earlier ones.

name: Mystagogue
description: The person who conducts Initiations; in the Luperci this is the magister for his college.

name: Skinchanger
description: A Virtue gained by Luperci postulants at the lupellis grade through a rite invoking Luperca.

name: Dark Secret
description: A Flaw gained at the lupellis Initiation, reflecting membership in a secret murderous cult; for magi it represents knowingly flouting the Hermetic Oath.

name: Scales of the Heart
description: A Power held by the She-Wolf that a lupercus can acquire as a Lesser Power Virtue. It costs one Fatigue level and needs no words or gestures.

name: Confession of the Penitent
description: A Power held by the She-Wolf that a lupercus can acquire as a Lesser Power Virtue instead of Scales of the Heart.

name: Lesser Power
description: A Virtue (and Magic Quality) granting a supernatural power; lupercus Initiates gain one of the She-Wolf's powers through it.

name: Judged Unfairly
description: A Minor Flaw representing the spiritual stain left by murders, gained at the lupercus Initiation.

name: Spiritual Pact
description: A Virtue gained by a magister luperci that lets him invoke the She-Wolf or other Aspects of the Daimon of Revenge.

name: Plagued by Supernatural Entity
description: A Major Flaw gained by a new magister luperci: the Daimon sends a creature of judgment to watch him and punish him when he acts inappropriately.

name: Aspect
description: A manifestation of a Daimon; the She-Wolf is an Aspect of the Daimon of Revenge and returns unharmed if slain.

name: Daimon
description: A powerful magical spirit that manifests through Aspects; Tytalus wrote a discourse on Daimons that represent emotions.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: A spell used to prepare the cave where condemned magi are punished, limiting their ability to fight back.

name: Hermetic Oath
description: The oath binding magi of the Order; Hermetic Luperci knowingly flout it whenever they inflict the wolf's judgment.

name: Tribunal
description: The Hermetic legal assembly that judges magi. Hermetic Luperci avenge crimes by magi whom a Tribunal found innocent.

name: Boundary
description: A mystical boundary that the Luperci's curse-dispelling power can affect without a ritual spell.

name: Perdo
description: The Hermetic Technique of destruction; Perdo Vim magic is usually stronger than the Luperci's power to dispel curses.

name: Vim
description: The Hermetic Form of magic itself, referenced in Perdo Vim curse-breaking magic.

name: Rego
description: The Hermetic Technique of control; a Wolf of Virtue has 2 pawns of Rego vis in its eyes and its Transfix power is ReCo(An).

name: Corpus
description: The Hermetic Form of the human body; the Transfix power affects Corpus or Animal.

name: Animal
description: The Hermetic Form of animals; the Wolf of Virtue has Magic Might (Animal).

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power found in creatures; the Wolf of Virtue carries 2 pawns of Rego vis in its eyes.

name: The Gift
description: The magical talent of magi; Gifted characters gain no special rank in non-Hermetic cults and are treated differently in Initiation.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: A non-Hermetic practitioner of magic; a non-Hermetic cult might have its own tradition of hedge wizards.

name: Magic Realm
description: The Realm of Power to which Wolves of Virtue and the Wolf's Court are aligned.

name: Magic Aura
description: A place aligned with the Magic Realm; the She-Wolf may move to another Magic aura if her fane is destroyed.

name: Majarida Mountains
description: The mountains around the Wolf's Court, home to unusually bold wolf packs that include Wolves of Virtue.

name: Wolf of Virtue
description: A magical wolf aligned to the Magic Realm that embodies wolfhood. Trained by the She-Wolf, it often leads a pack and has the Transfix power.

name: Wolf
description: A pack predator of the Majarida Mountains with full statistics, hunting in the phases of stalk, encounter, rush, chase and kill.

name: Large Wolf
description: A wolf up to twice normal weight, usually the leading male of a pack.

name: Werewolf
description: A human who changes into a wolf; the She-Wolf grants this power to people seeking vengeance.

name: Shapeshifter
description: A being that changes form. They are known in Mythic Europe, but a rash of them in one place may arouse suspicion.

name: Great Beast
description: A Bjornaer magus with a wolf heartbeast who has passed into Final Twilight and might roam among the forest's wolf packs.

name: Transfix
description: A Wolf of Virtue's power that leaves prey unable to move or speak while the wolf keeps eye contact; it fails if the wolf is seen first. It is ReCo(An) 20.

name: Long-Winded
description: A Virtue that wolves possess, which helps on Fatigue rolls during the rush and the chase.

name: Large
description: A Virtue held by the Large Wolf.

name: Puissant Brawl
description: A Virtue held by the Large Wolf and the Wolf of Virtue.

name: Puissant Hunt
description: A Virtue held by the Wolf of Virtue.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: A Virtue (and Magic Quality) taken multiple times by wolves in their stat blocks.

name: Ferocity
description: A Virtue held by wolves, active when leading a pack or when hungry.

name: Compulsion
description: A Flaw (killing) held by ordinary wolves.

name: Infamous
description: A Flaw held by wolves in their stat blocks.

name: Magic Animal
description: A Virtue marking the Wolf of Virtue as a magical animal.

name: Magical Monster
description: A Virtue in the Wolf of Virtue's stat block.

name: Inspirational
description: A Virtue the Wolf of Virtue uses to make its pack braver, more loyal or more willing to take risks.

name: Lesser Immunity
description: A Virtue (to Exposure) held by the Wolf of Virtue.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: A Virtue and Ability held by the Wolf of Virtue.

name: Greedy
description: A Flaw held by the Wolf of Virtue.

name: Master of Animal Creatures
description: A Virtue the She-Wolf uses to train the magical wolves of the Majarida.

name: Magic Might
description: The measure of a magical creature's power; the Wolf of Virtue has Magic Might 10 (Animal).

name: Essential Trait
description: A personality trait fundamental to a magical creature's nature, such as the Wolf of Virtue's Hungry and Wolf traits.

name: Restricted Power
description: A Magic Inferiority on the Wolf of Virtue that makes its Transfix power fail if the target sees the wolf first.

name: Awareness
description: An Ability used with Perception to find tracks and notice stalking predators.

name: Hunt
description: An Ability used to follow tracks and in the Pursuit Total.

name: Stealth
description: An Ability used by stalkers and to hide a trail.

name: Athletics
description: An Ability used in Rush, Fatigue and Evasion rolls during wolf hunts.

name: Brawl
description: An Ability used by wolves for teeth attacks and trip maneuvers.

name: Leadership
description: An Ability that sets how many wolves attack as a trained group and lets the leader swap attackers.

name: Survival
description: An Ability held by wolves (winter).

name: Area Lore
description: An Ability held by the Wolf of Virtue (prey).

name: Music
description: An Ability held by the Wolf of Virtue (wolf-songs).

name: Trained Group
description: A combat rule under which wolves attack as a trained group led by the pack leader, who applies the Group Advantage to the Attack Total.

name: Trip
description: A Brawl maneuver wolves use to knock prey down during the kill.

name: Hunted by Wolves
description: This chapter's rules for wolf hunts in five phases: stalk, encounter, rush, chase and kill.

name: Fatigue
description: Short and Long Term Fatigue levels lost on failed rolls during the rush and the chase.

name: Story Flaw
description: A class of Flaw such as Enemies or Feud that can bring a supplicant to the Wolf's Court.

name: Enemies
description: A Story Flaw suited to a character seeking justice at the Wolf's Court.

name: Feud
description: A Story Flaw suited to a character seeking justice at the Wolf's Court.

name: Baudouin
description: A villager who says he killed an attacking wolf that turned into the corpse of his brother Guillot; he is accused of murder.

name: Guillot
description: Baudouin's brother, whose naked corpse lay where the slain wolf had been; he was his brother's rival for Odette.

name: Odette
description: A local maiden who witnessed the attack and supports Baudouin's story.

name: Bisclavret
description: The hero of Marie de France's lai: a werewolf knight with a human mind, trapped in wolf form when his faithless wife stole his clothes.

name: Marie de France
description: A twelfth-century author who retold the Breton lai Bisclavret.

name: Ovid
description: The Roman poet whose Fasti is the best source on the She-Wolf's Roman history.

name: Fasti
description: Ovid's poem on festivals, a summa on Organization Lore: Roman Empire (Level 3, Quality 8).

name: Tytalus
description: A Founder of the Order who wrote a discourse on Daimons of emotions such as rivalry and victory.

name: Prosopopoeia
description: Tytalus's summa on Magic Lore (Level 4, Quality 9); it names the She-Wolf as an Aspect of Poine.

name: Rome
description: The city whose histories cover the She-Wolf and the festival of Lupercalia.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of magi, founded on fairness and equity, which is likely to find the vigilante Luperci repugnant.

name: Wizard's War
description: A sanctioned Hermetic conflict between magi; the She-Wolf could help a magus facing a powerful foe in one.

name: House Bjornaer
description: A shapechanging Hermetic House that may use the Wolf's Court as an Ancestor Site and is feuding with the Pomeranian Witches.

name: Bjornaer Council
description: The council of House Bjornaer, which would task a magus with approaching the She-Wolf.

name: Ancestor Site
description: A place strongly resonating with shapechanging and the Magic Realm that serves House Bjornaer; the Wolf's Court could be one.

name: Heartbeast
description: The animal nature of a Bjornaer magus, such as a wolf.

name: Final Twilight
description: The final passage of a magus into Twilight; a Bjornaer magus who undergoes it may become a Great Beast.

name: Pomeranian Witches
description: A Shapeshifter Cult in a vicious feud with House Bjornaer.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting, where shapeshifters are hardly unknown.
